description: Malicious file-preview worktree for the locus-preview broker (design D7 option (a), verification GP-05). 'site/index.html' is the admitted document; its default declared asset scope is the 'site/' subtree. 'secret-parent.txt' is out of scope (parent directory of the document), 'other/private.txt' is an out-of-scope sibling, and 'site/escape-assets' is created by the test as a directory symlink to a directory outside the registered root.
